title: Hearing on New York City's coastal flood protection efforts
summary: The Council's Environmental Protection and Waterfronts Committee held an oversight hearing on coastal resilience, reviewing the City's post-Superstorm Sandy recovery programs and ongoing shoreline protection projects across the five boroughs. The hearing also examined three related bills: exempting solar panel installations from certain fees, creating a mobile drinking fountain program, and establishing a new Department of Coastal Protection. Background materials describe sea level rise projections, the Build It Back program's status as of July 2026, and the status of over a dozen active coastal infrastructure projects managed by agencies like DEP, DDC and NYCEDC.
